conventions.convention: Mixtures are Borel probability measures on a nonempty compact K ⊂ R^d; barycenter and energy are coordinatewise Lebesgue integrals, and the energy infimum has a prescribed barycenter.
The finite-site shell is centered at NE(β), includes its boundary, and carries the uniform law. The block theorem requires δ_N ≥ qΣ_j|e_j| and δ_N/N → 0, with finite real β.
The collision model adopts the absolutely convergent weak identity with factor 1/4 and incoming-minus-outgoing test bracket; symmetry of the collision measure is an assumption.

Collision entropy uses log(f/f_ref) with a positive constant reference density. The Maxwellian equality branch additionally requires full support, local finiteness, velocity C² regularity, and velocity integrability.

The Hamiltonian sign is contraction of X_H with ω equal to dH. Recurrence concerns almost every point for the specified sampled map on finite measure; the space-mean conclusion additionally requires ergodicity.

OU solutions satisfy the pathwise integral equation on a common probability-one event, with an adapted Brownian motion whose future increments are independent of the present filtration and a square-integrable F_0-measurable initial variable.
The OU spectral convention is S(ω) = (2π)⁻¹∫ C(τ)e^{iωτ}dτ; the stationary covariance and time-average variance bound concern the stationary Gaussian initialization.

Regular-shell measure is graph area weighted by |∇H|⁻¹, not unweighted area or a formal delta distribution. Normalization requires positive finite mass; the theorem assumes AC, C² energy, regular levels, and compact inverse images of compact energy sets.
The ideal-gas reference measure is dq dp/(N!h^{dN}); its exact-energy preparation is normalized Gaussian momentum, and its block convergence is weak convergence, not finite-width-shell equivalence.

Quantum phases are e^{-iE_jt/ℏ}, the inner product is linear in its first argument, and Cesàro dephasing retains entire degenerate energy blocks. The eigenbasis interface is used conditionally from the draft Gibbs supplier.

load_bearing.statement: Under AC, for C² Hamiltonian energy on an open canonical Euclidean domain, with nonzero gradient on H⁻¹(J) and compact inverse images of compact subsets of J, the weighted shell measure satisfies coarea for nonnegative compactly supported Borel functions and has positive finite mass on every nonempty level. Its normalized measure is invariant under a Hamiltonian diffeomorphism preserving a full compact band containing the level.

For the stated positive regular periodic solution, moment and entropy integrability, compact-time derivative domination, transport integrability, spatial collision-production integrability, and absolutely convergent weak identities, H′ = −(1/4)∫∫(A−B)log(A/B) ≤ 0. Equality is exactly collision balance almost everywhere; the additional full-support, local-finiteness and C² hypotheses yield the quadratic logarithmic velocity form, with negative quadratic coefficient when velocity integrable.

Under AC, smooth Hamiltonian local flows preserve symplectic form and volume wherever defined. Finite-measure forward-invariant sampled regions give almost-everywhere recurrence; probability and ergodicity additionally give almost-everywhere and L¹ convergence of integrable sampled averages to the space mean. Invertible invariant flow transport conserves the stated absolutely integrable fine-grained entropy.

Assuming AC and the exact draft Gibbs eigenbasis interface, the trace-norm Riemann Cesàro average of U_tρU_t* for any positive trace-one trace-class density converges to Σ_E P_EρP_E, retaining full degenerate blocks; expectations of bounded observables converge accordingly.

For nonempty compact K ⊂ R^d and continuous a, every prescribed x ∈ conv K has an energy-minimizing Borel probability supported on at most d+1 points. The mixture energy is lower semicontinuous, convex, and the greatest convex minorant of a on K; minimization over all probabilities and finite mixtures gives the same attained value.
Elastic collisions conserve pair momentum and squared speed; a symmetric collision measure and the displayed absolutely convergent weak identity define the adopted collision model.

For a C² energy on an open Euclidean domain, regular levels have nonzero gradient. A supplied graph partition defines the candidate shell integral using |∂_iH|⁻¹ dz; a positive finite total mass permits normalization.

For a finite alphabet with additive single-site energies, canonical probabilities are proportional to e^{-βe_j}; the narrow shell is |H_N−NE(β)| ≤ δ_N and its microcanonical law is uniform when nonempty.
A continuous adapted solution satisfies X_t = X_0−γ∫₀ᵗX_s ds+σB_t almost surely for every time, under the stated Brownian filtration hypothesis, γ,σ>0, and finite second moment of X_0.
On nonempty compact K with continuous energy a, a mixture is a Borel probability, and its barycenter-constrained energy is the infimum of its mean energy.
